title: Prior Authorization Checklist
subtitle: Capture service request, medical-necessity reference, payer route, and decision period; confirm denial reason and appeal.
description: Prior Authorization records service request, medical-necessity reference, payer route, decision period, denial reason, and appeal. Prior Authorization evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this prior authorization stage-gated verification when staff must document service request and medical-necessity reference. Reconcile payer route, decision period, denial reason, and appeal before the prior authorization handoff. Use the payer form or portal record, procedure or service details, medical-necessity support, submission proof, pending-request log, approval terms, denial letter, and appeal receipt. This workflow follows the payer decision itself through portal submission, pending status, information request, approval scope, units or date limits, denial rationale, peer review, resubmission, and appeal. Record authorization number, certified quantity, approved site, validity window, case reviewer, fax or portal transaction, determination letter, reconsideration appointment, and escalation deadline. Ask the assigned prior authorization reviewer to confirm service request against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Prior Authorization starting details review
sections.guidance: Track service request, medical-necessity evidence, payer portal or call reference, decision period, approval scope, denial reason, resubmission, and appeal deadline. Keep any urgent prior authorization issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Prior Authorization checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current prior authorization facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Prior Authorization required checks
items: Service request is identified for this record
Medical-necessity reference matches the current request or source
Payer route is ready for point-of-use staff
Decision period limits or questions are resolved
Denial reason is communicated to the responsible person
A changed prior authorization fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Prior Authorization failed or pending items

sections.title: Prior Authorization readiness and handoff
sections.guidance: Hold prior authorization readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Prior Authorization reviewer receipt

fields.label: Receiving department or clinical reviewer and date

blocks.guidance: Prior Authorization receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
